# `foxglove custom-properties`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](README.md)

```text
List and manage custom properties

Usage: foxglove custom-properties [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Create a custom property
  delete  Delete a custom property
  edit    Edit a custom property's label or enum values
  get     Get a custom property
  list    List custom properties
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
